text:
If your weekend plans hinge on sunshine, hang tight through midday, because the back half of today is where it gets good. That cold front sliding through this morning is behind the scattered showers and even an isolated storm possible before early afternoon, though the Euro thinks that rain sticks around a lot longer and heavier than the American model does, so keep the rain jacket within reach through lunch just in case. Once the front clears, expect a genuine flip: north winds usher in cooler, drier air and mostly sunny skies for the afternoon, with a high near 73. Clear skies hold overnight with a cool, comfortable low around 53.

Saturday is the payoff, sunny with a high near 78 and calm winds, easily the better of the two lake days this weekend, with the water sitting at a swimmable 73 and waves staying a foot or less most of the day. If you're headed to the waterfront, today's best window is after the front clears, say 2pm on; Saturday you've got the whole day. Enjoy the stretch, because the AFD is already flagging rain returning by Monday night.

Afternoon storms possible after 2, high near 79, with better rain odds once the sun goes down.
Mostly dry Monday, high near 77, with just a slight chance of showers after dark.
Scattered showers and storms possible much of the day, high near 79, keep the rain gear handy.
Rain showers likely most of the day, high near 78, an umbrella kind of Wednesday.
Showers taper off some Thursday, partly sunny, high near 78, a bit drier than the day before.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) -Happy Friday! Our Friday starts with some leftover cloud cover and a few highly isolated passing rain showers to start the day. Dewpoints are still a bit elevated, so you may notice it feels a tad muggy. Through the day though, the cold front starts to pass through the area and winds begin to pick up out of the north, ushering in cooler and sunnier weather. By later this afternoon and evening, it looks like the sunshine is rather abundant. Highs for the day climb back into the mid and upper 70s this afternoon. Clear skies stick around tonight, which will result in a cool night. Overnight lows by early Saturday morning are in the 40s for most of us, and some of the usual cooler spots could even wake up to temperatures in the upper 30s.
